facts.value: Dispatches an ID-tagged variadic effect request to generator creation, async/alternate dispatchers or local construction recipes. Returns a nullable primary generator/effect/chain head. Construction may fail or create only part of a composition; unreturned secondary objects can still be created when the primary result is NULL.

evidence.why: Secondary generator independent of primary success.
Secondary generator can survive NULL model result.

facts.value: Resets AnimCount and LoadKind to0. Remaps0x479 to0x506 only when efAsync_DatEntries[1].data is NULL. Signed gfx_id<0x250 (including negatives) or integer quotient gfx_id/1000==30 routes to generator creation with Vec3*. Remaining0x250..0x477 delegates to efAsync_Dispatch;0x478..0x4B9 delegates to efAlt_Spawn. Other values set sync mode and enter the local switch;0x4BA and unsupported values return NULL after its epilogue. Local epilogue decrements AnimCount and animates pointer-sized queue slots in reverse order, then va_end. Early return routes bypass this local epilogue/va_end, and delegates can change LoadKind themselves. Resetting count does not clear queue bytes. Global loading/count state is not saved/restored.
facts.rationale: Correct routing boundaries and delegated mode assumptions.

facts.value: Local recipes consume ordered JObj*/Vec3*/f32* payloads; some trailing pointers are read only after successful primary allocation. Scale helpers generally use owner Y scale uniformly, while selected recipes copy full scale.0x4CF/0x4D0 build up to12 linked model effects, stopping on first failure and keeping the partial chain; each successful node gets lifetime50, random rotations and a magnitude2 motion vector.0x4BF/0x507 create unreturned secondary generators regardless of primary success;0x4BB/0x4BC/0x4DA/0x50B link a second effect only after primary success.

Canonical void* efSync_Spawn(s32 gfx_id,HSD_GObj* gobj,...); header calls second parameter arg_gobj. Return is a nullable HSD_Generator*,EF_Effect* or EF_Effect chain head depending on ID, without a runtime tag. Local scalar payloads are f32 pointers, not promoted floating arguments; exact arity/type/order depend on recipe and delegated dispatchers. Some IDs ignore gobj; fighter-specific0x4FF..0x501 dereference fighter data/parts without local type validation.
facts.rationale: Record actual variadic ABI and conditional owner requirements.

facts.value: Resets AnimCount and LoadKind to0. Remaps0x479 to0x506 only when efAsync_DatEntries[1].data is NULL. Signed gfx_id<0x250 (including negatives) or integer quotient gfx_id/1000==30 routes to generator creation with Vec3*. Remaining0x250..0x477 delegates to efAsync_Dispatch;0x478..0x4B9 delegates to efAlt_Spawn. Other values set sync mode and enter the local switch;0x4BA and unsupported values return NULL after its epilogue. Delegation does not imply the mode stays asynchronous: efAlt sets synchronous mode and efAsync has synchronous cases. Local animation processing pops reverse pointer slots and leaves mode synchronous; count0 hides prior queue contents without clearing them. No local rollback frees prior successful effects when a compound recipe later fails.
facts.rationale: Correct TU-wide state and partial-success guarantees.
